chapters.label: Live: the 2026 semi-final
chapters.text: Futsal Euro semi-final, 2026. Portugal lead France, four to one. France push up with an extra attacker. Mouhoudine shoots from close. Bernardo Paçó saves!

chapters.label: Full time
chapters.text: Full time. Portugal win four to one and reach the final. His twin brother, Tomás, was Player of the Match!

chapters.label: How he blocks (demo)
chapters.text: This is how he blocks. The shot is too close to dive, so he stays big: arms wide, and one leg shoots out along the floor. Blocked!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Practise with a friend. In futsal, stay big and use your legs to block close shots!
